CITY OF LA VERNE
  DEVELOPMENT REVIEW COMMITTEE
  ACTION MINUTES

Eric Scherer, Chair  City Hall
Cody Howing, City Engineer  3660 “D” Street
Danny Wu, Public Works  La Verne, CA 91750
  (909) 596-8706
  www.cityoflaverne.org

  Tuesday, September 2, 2025 – 9:00 a.m.
  City Hall Council Chambers
  3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Development Review Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Development Review Committee
with valuable information. Regular Meetings are held on the 1st Tuesday of every month. In
compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s
Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

The Council Chambers will be open to the public at 9:00 a.m. Materials related to an item on this
agenda, submitted to the Development Review Committee after distribution of the agenda packet,
are available for public inspection at the meeting or in the Community Development Department during
normal business hours.

  1. CALL TO ORDER

  Mr. Howing called the meeting to order at 9:00am.

  Voting members present: Cody Howing, Candice Bowcock, & Danny Wu.

  Others present: Assistant Planner Valerie Chin, Fire Marshal Fred St. Ange, Utility
  Supervisor Ralph Hernandez, and Utility Manager Ryan Ciotti.

  2. PUBLIC COMMENT
 Development Review Committee Action Minutes – September 2, 2025
Page 2

  This is the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the Development Review
  Committee on items not listed in any other place on this agenda.

  California Law does not allow the Development Review Committee to take action in
  response to your statements at this meeting. Your concerns may be referred to
  staff or set for hearing at a later date.

  None

  3. APPROVAL OF ACTION MINUTES – May 6, 2025

  Mr. Howing made a motion to approve the minutes and Mr. Wu seconded. Motion
  carried by a 3-0 vote.

  APPROVAL OF ACTION MINUTES – July 1, 2025

  Mr. Howing made a motion to approve the minutes and Ms. Bowcock seconded.
  Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  4. PROJECT REVIEWS
  Note: Due to time constraints, discussion on these items will be limited to 30
  minutes each.

  PROJECT:  PRECISE PLAN REVIEW FOR FACADE CHANGES TO
  EXISTING STOREFRONT AND CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMITS FOR TO ALLOW FOR THE SALE OF GENERAL
  ALCOHOL FOR OFF-SITE CONSUMPTION IN
  CONJUNCTION WITH A GROCERY STORE WITHIN THE
  FOOTHILL BOULEVARD SPECIFIC PLAN
  CASE NOS:  63-25PPR, 71-25CUP AND 72-25CUP
  ADDRESS:  1504 FOOTHILL BOULEVARD
  Project Planners: Valerie Chin, Assistant Planner and Kaitlyn Cavan,
  Planning Intern

  Environmental:  Categorically exempt per Section 15301 (Class 1)

  Action: The applicant, Steve Rawlings from Rawlings Consulting OBO Grocery
  Outlet Inc. was present at the meeting.

  Ms. Chin presented the report.

  It was moved by Ms. Bowcock and seconded by Mr. Wu to continue the 63-25PPR
  to the next DRC meeting as staff have not received the requested elevations.
  Motion carried 3-0.

  2
   It was moved by Ms. Bowcock and seconded by Mr. Wu to recommend approval to
  the Planning Commission for Case Numbers 71-25CUP and 72-25CUP.

5. ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting adjourned at 9:11 a.m. The next meeting of the Development Review
  Committee is scheduled to be held on October 7, 2025 at 9:00 a.m. at City Hall,
  3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750.

  Respectfully submitted,

  Natalie Hiatt, Administrative Secretary
